Hostage pizza bites.d: Sixteen thin dough rounds, each with tomato, mozzarella and a slice of pepperoni, baked crisp underneath.

Brooklyn potato knishes.d: Mashed with onion cooked slow in butter and white pepper, rolled in puff pastry, baked golden. Hot mustard.

Manhattan steak sandwich.d: Seared hard, rested and sliced thin, with onions cooked down jammy, arugula and horseradish cream. Bread toasted.

Rainbow cookies.d: Three almond layers, green, white and red, with apricot jam between and dark chocolate on top.

Negotiator's espresso orange tonic.d: A double shot floated over ice-cold tonic water and a slice of orange. Stir before you sip.
